reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes that adding 10-15 at.% Pt to equiatomic FeCoNi will induce L1₀ ordering; FePt L1₀ requires near-equiatomic Fe-Pt ratios and high-temperature annealing, and the proposed 350°C/30s RTA is far too low and short to drive ordering, making the mechanism physically unsound.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and includes a specific falsification criterion (10× coercivity increase and L1₀ signatures), but the hypothesis itself is so physically implausible that the test would almost certainly falsify it, making the test decisive but trivial.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a mechanism (L1₀ ordering via low-temperature RTA) that contradicts well-established phase transformation kinetics in Fe-Pt systems, and it fails to address the high-entropy alloy constraint of maintaining near-equiatomic proportions.
